description: This Java class 'DateParam' provides functionality for parsing date strings received as query parameters in API requests, including constants for parameter names and a method for converting string input into LocalDate objects based on specified formats and locales.

classes.name: DateParam
classes.description: Provides methods to handle date parameters in API requests, including parsing date strings into LocalDate objects.

methods.name: DateParam
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the date string to be parsed.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Converts the stored date string into a LocalDate object based on provided parameter name, date format, and locale.
